named_subject: a straw broom (long handle, splayed bristle strands)
action: The broom stands tilted to the left with its bristles on the floor and sways and shifts slightly up, down and sideways, dropping lower around frames 5 and 13.
identity_gap: The animated broom uses the same construction as the doodle (a double-line handle, a fan of separate bristle strokes, one long stroke sweeping out to the right) but is held at a steep tilt instead of upright, and the bristle strokes are denser and change in count between frames.
notes: The broom's position tracks the film's main broom only loosely: the film shows the broom lowering, swinging right and other brooms passing through, while the drawing mostly jitters in place and then jumps right and down at frames 12-13 before snapping back at 14; the grey scenery brooms stay fixed even though the film's background brooms move. The change that would help most is to move the black broom smoothly along the film broom's path (especially frames 11-14) with a stable set of bristle strokes so it does not pop.
